answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using hardware remote attestation. An agent derives a unique key inside a hardware enclave and submits a quote signed by a factory-fused root key, a permanent silicon relic. A verification jetty checks OEM root certificates and deduplicates chip IDs, rejecting emulators lacking hardware pigment. Attackers incur the verifiable cost of dedicated physical chips per identity. However, side-channel key extraction still enables forged accounts.
